# shellcheck shell=bash
if ! has nix_direnv_version || ! nix_direnv_version 3.0.6; then
  source_url "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nix-community/nix-direnv/3.0.6/direnvrc" \
    "sha256-RYcUJaRMf8oF5LznDrlCXbkOQrywm0HDv1VjYGaJGdM="
fi

watch_file dev/flake.nix
watch_file nix/flake/dev-partition.nix

export AGENT_SANDBOX_DIRENV_ACTIVE=1
export AGENT_SANDBOX_DIRENV_OWNER_PID
AGENT_SANDBOX_DIRENV_OWNER_PID=$(ps -o ppid= -p "$PPID" | tr -d ' ')
export AGENT_SANDBOX_PROJECT_ROOT
AGENT_SANDBOX_PROJECT_ROOT=$(readlink -f "$PWD")

use flake

agent_sandbox_project_name=$(basename "$AGENT_SANDBOX_PROJECT_ROOT")
agent_sandbox_project_id=$(printf '%s' "$agent_sandbox_project_name" | tr -c 'A-Za-z0-9_.-' '-' | cut -c1-40)
[[ $agent_sandbox_project_id != . && $agent_sandbox_project_id != .. ]] || agent_sandbox_project_id=worktree
export DOCKER_SOCK="$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/agent-sandbox-docker-$agent_sandbox_project_id/docker.sock"
export DOCKER_HOST="unix://$DOCKER_SOCK"

if [[ -z ${CI:-} && ${AGENT_SANDBOX_SKIP_DOCKER_DAEMON:-} != 1 ]]; then
  agent-docker-daemon \
    "$AGENT_SANDBOX_DIRENV_OWNER_PID" 1 "$AGENT_SANDBOX_PROJECT_ROOT"
fi

    devshell: configure isolated Docker bridge
    
    Docker 29 rejects --bridge and --bip when they are passed together, so the
    project-local daemon exits before creating its socket. Create and address the
    per-shell bridge explicitly, then constrain Docker's address allocation with
    --fixed-cidr. Remove the bridge with the rest of the daemon's transient state.

+          bridge_address="10.254.$bridge_octet.1/24"
+          bridge_cidr="10.254.$bridge_octet.0/24"
 
           cleanup() {

+            ip link delete "$bridge" 2>/dev/null || true

           }

@@ -42,9 +46,13 @@

+          ip link set "$bridge" up
+

             --bridge "$bridge" \
+            --fixed-cidr "$bridge_cidr" \

content.text: The automatic `direnv` path runs interactive `sudo -v`, so directory entry waits for PAM fingerprint and password handling. I will make that path use cached, non-interactive authorization and keep interactive authorization only for direct `nix develop`.

arguments.command:
AGENT_SANDBOX_SKIP_DOCKER_DAEMON=1 nix develop --command bash -c '
set -euo pipefail
test_root=$(mktemp -d -t agent-sandbox-sudo-test.XXXXXX)
trap '\''rm -rf "$test_root"'\'' EXIT
mkdir "$test_root/bin" "$test_root/project"
cat >"$test_root/bin/sudo" <<'\''EOF'\''
#!/usr/bin/env bash
printf "%s\n" "$*" >"$SUDO_CALL_LOG"
exit 42
EOF
chmod +x "$test_root/bin/sudo"
export PATH="$test_root/bin:$PATH"
export SUDO_CALL_LOG="$test_root/call"
start=$(date +%s)
if agent-docker-daemon "$$" 1 "$test_root/project" 2>"$test_root/error"; then
  exit 1
fi
test $(( $(date +%s) - start )) -lt 2
grep -Fx -- "--non-interactive -v" "$SUDO_CALL_LOG"
! grep -F "Authorizing" "$test_root/error"

if agent-docker-daemon "$$" 0 "$test_root/project" 2>"$test_root/error"; then
  exit 1
fi
grep -Fx -- "-v" "$SUDO_CALL_LOG"
grep -F "Authorizing the ephemeral Docker daemon" "$test_root/error"
'

b2cb04a devshell: avoid sudo prompts during direnv load
devshell: avoid sudo prompts during direnv load

Direnv starts the Docker daemon with an interactive sudo check. PAM can wait for fingerprint input or a password, so changing directories can block.

Use only cached sudo authorization during direnv loads. Keep the prompt for direct development shells, and add a check for the non-interactive path.

sudo_status=1
sudo: a password is required

# shellcheck shell=bash
if ! has nix_direnv_version || ! nix_direnv_version 3.0.6; then
  source_url "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nix-community/nix-direnv/3.0.6/direnvrc" \
    "sha256-RYcUJaRMf8oF5LznDrlCXbkOQrywm0HDv1VjYGaJGdM="
fi

watch_file dev/flake.nix
watch_file nix/flake/dev-partition.nix

export AGENT_SANDBOX_DIRENV_ACTIVE=1
export AGENT_SANDBOX_DIRENV_OWNER_PID
AGENT_SANDBOX_DIRENV_OWNER_PID=$(ps -o ppid= -p "$PPID" | tr -d ' ')
export AGENT_SANDBOX_PROJECT_ROOT
AGENT_SANDBOX_PROJECT_ROOT=$(readlink -f "$PWD")

use flake

agent_sandbox_project_name=$(basename "$AGENT_SANDBOX_PROJECT_ROOT")
agent_sandbox_project_id=$(printf '%s' "$agent_sandbox_project_name" | tr -c 'A-Za-z0-9_.-' '-' | cut -c1-40)
[[ $agent_sandbox_project_id != . && $agent_sandbox_project_id != .. ]] || agent_sandbox_project_id=worktree
export DOCKER_SOCK="$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/agent-sandbox-docker-$agent_sandbox_project_id/docker.sock"
export DOCKER_HOST="unix://$DOCKER_SOCK"

if [[ -z ${CI:-} && ${AGENT_SANDBOX_SKIP_DOCKER_DAEMON:-} != 1 ]]; then
  agent-docker-daemon \
    "$AGENT_SANDBOX_DIRENV_OWNER_PID" 1 "$AGENT_SANDBOX_PROJECT_ROOT"
fi
diff --git a/.envrc b/.envrc
index fcfa2a3..f6b635a 100644
--- a/.envrc
+++ b/.envrc
@@ -22,6 +22,11 @@ export DOCKER_SOCK="$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/agent-sandbox-docker-$agent_sandbox_project
 export DOCKER_HOST="unix://$DOCKER_SOCK"
 
 if [[ -z ${CI:-} && ${AGENT_SANDBOX_SKIP_DOCKER_DAEMON:-} != 1 ]]; then
-  agent-docker-daemon \
-    "$AGENT_SANDBOX_DIRENV_OWNER_PID" 1 "$AGENT_SANDBOX_PROJECT_ROOT"
+  if command -v sudo >/dev/null && sudo --non-interactive -v 2>/dev/null; then
+    agent-docker-daemon \
+      "$AGENT_SANDBOX_DIRENV_OWNER_PID" 1 "$AGENT_SANDBOX_PROJECT_ROOT"
+  else
+    echo 'The Docker daemon did not start because sudo authorization is not cached.' >&2
+    echo 'Run sudo -v and direnv reload to start it.' >&2
+  fi
 fi
diff --git a/nix/flake/dev-partition.nix b/nix/flake/dev-partition.nix
index 67c9907..ff8cc82 100644
--- a/nix/flake/dev-partition.nix
+++ b/nix/flake/dev-partition.nix
@@ -157,15 +157,20 @@
             exit 1
           fi
 
-          echo 'Authorizing the ephemeral Docker daemon for this development shell.' >&2
-          sudo -v
+          sudo_arguments=()
+          if [[ "$watch_cwd" == 1 ]]; then
+            sudo_arguments+=(--non-interactive)
+          else
+            echo 'Authorizing the ephemeral Docker daemon for this development shell.' >&2
+          fi
+          sudo "''${sudo_arguments[@]}" -v
 
           : >"$log"
 
           # The runner serializes replacement and validates stale PIDs before
           # killing them. The caller opens its user-owned log before sudo.
           # shellcheck disable=SC2024
-          sudo -b ${runDockerDaemon}/bin/agent-dockerd-runner \
+          sudo "''${sudo_arguments[@]}" -b ${runDockerDaemon}/bin/agent-dockerd-runner \
             "$owner_pid" "$watch_cwd" "$project_root" "$project_id" \
             >"$log" 2>&1
 
@@ -234,6 +239,12 @@
         agent-systemd-nspawn = agentSandboxChecks.nspawnApp;

mkdir -p "$(dirname "$_BUILDERS_FILE")"
                touch "$_BUILDERS_FILE"
                touch "$_BUILDERS_CONF"

                export NIX_CONFIG="builders = @$_BUILDERS_FILE
                keep-going = true
                builders-use-substitutes = true"

                # Dynamic config written by verify-remote-builders.sh (max-jobs = 0
                # when remote builders are available). Preserve existing user conf.
                export NIX_USER_CONF_FILES="$_BUILDERS_CONF:''${NIX_USER_CONF_FILES:-''${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-''$HOME/.config}/nix/nix.conf}"

                # Fully detach discovery so shell activation never waits on SSH checks.
                # Close all inherited extra FDs first; otherwise direnv may wait for
                # long-lived children that keep its internal pipe FDs open.
                /usr/bin/env bash -c '
                  exec </dev/null >/tmp/neocache-verify-remote-builders.log 2>&1
                  for _fd_path in /proc/$$/fd/*; do
                    _fd="''${_fd_path##*/}"
                    [ "$_fd" -ge 3 ] 2>/dev/null || continue
                    eval "exec ''${_fd}>&-"
                  done
                  exec setsid -f "$1" "$2"
                ' _ ./scripts/verify-remote-builders.sh "$_BUILDERS_FILE"

                ${cargoTargetDirShellHook}
                # Set up DOCKER_HOST and DOCKER_SOCK for k3d to use Podman
                # DOCKER_HOST: Used by k3d to connect to the container runtime API
                # DOCKER_SOCK: Used by k3d to determine the socket path to mount into the tools container
                export DOCKER_HOST="unix://''${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR}/podman/podman.sock"
                export DOCKER_SOCK="''${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR}/podman/podman.sock"

                # Ensure cgroup v2 cpuset delegation for rootless k3d/k3s
                # This requires sudo but persists until reboot
                _setup_cgroup_delegation() {
                  local needs_setup=0
                  local needs_reexec=0

                  if ! grep -q cpuset /sys/fs/cgroup/cgroup.subtree_control 2>/dev/null; then
                    needs_setup=1
                  fi
                  if ! grep -q cpuset /sys/fs/cgroup/user.slice/cgroup.subtree_control 2>/dev/null; then
                    needs_setup=1
                  fi

                  if [ ! -f /run/systemd/system/user@.service.d/delegate.conf ]; then
                    needs_setup=1
                    needs_reexec=1
                  fi

                  if ! grep -q cpuset /sys/fs/cgroup/user.slice/user-$(id -u).slice/user@$(id -u).service/cgroup.controllers 2>/dev/null; then
                    needs_reexec=1
                  fi

                  if [ "$needs_setup" = "1" ]; then
                    if ! sudo -n true 2>/dev/null; then
                      >&2 echo '⚠️  Skipping cgroup v2 delegation setup; sudo requires a password.'
                      return 0
                    fi
                    >&2 echo '⚙️  Setting up cgroup v2 delegation for rootless k3d (requires sudo)...'
                    echo "+cpuset" | sudo tee -a /sys/fs/cgroup/cgroup.subtree_control >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
                    echo "+cpuset" | sudo tee -a /sys/fs/cgroup/user.slice/cgroup.subtree_control >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
                    sudo mkdir -p /run/systemd/system/user@.service.d
                    echo -e '[Service]\nDelegate=cpu cpuset io memory pids' | sudo tee /run/systemd/system/user@.service.d/delegate.conf >/dev/null
                    sudo systemctl daemon-reload
                    >&2 echo '✓ cgroup delegation configured'
                  fi

                  if [ "$needs_reexec" = "1" ]; then
                    >&2 echo '⚙️  Restarting user session to apply delegation...'
                    systemctl --user daemon-reexec
                    sleep 0.5
                    >&2 echo '✓ User session restarted'
                  fi
                }

                _setup_cgroup_delegation

                # Ensure the socket directory exists
                mkdir -p "''${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR}/podman"

                # Try to start Podman socket - prefer systemd if available, otherwise start manually
                # Note: We check for the socket file, not `podman info`, because podman works
                # without the socket but k3d needs the Docker-compatible socket API.
                _socket_path="''${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR}/podman/podman.sock"
                if [ -S "$_socket_path" ]; then
                  :
                elif systemctl --user is-active --quiet podman.socket 2>/dev/null; then
                  :
                elif systemctl --user start podman.socket 2>/dev/null; then
                  :
                else
                  >&2 echo 'Starting Podman socket service...'
                  # --log-level=error suppresses harmless /var/run mount warnings
                  # emitted by rootless Podman when exposing the Docker-compatible socket.
                  systemd-run --user --unit=podman-socket-nix --quiet \
                    podman --log-level=error system service --time=0 "unix://$_socket_path"
                  for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do
                    if [ -S "$_socket_path" ]; then
                      break
                    fi
                    sleep 0.2
                  done
                fi

                # Note: We don't clean up the socket on exit because direnv evaluates
                # shellHook in a subprocess - any EXIT trap fires immediately when that
                # subprocess ends, not when your shell exits. The socket stays running
                # until you manually stop it or reboot, which is fine.
                _podman_ready=0
                if [ -S "$_socket_path" ]; then
                  _podman_ready=1
                fi

                >&2 echo
                >&2 echo '☸️  Kubernetes Development Shell'
                >&2 echo
                >&2 echo 'Available tools:'
                >&2 echo '  kubectl        - Kubernetes CLI'
                >&2 echo '  helm           - Helm package manager'
                >&2 echo '  k3d            - k3s in Podman (local cluster)'
                >&2 echo '  podman         - Container engine'
                >&2 echo '  k9s            - Terminal UI for Kubernetes'
                >&2 echo '  stern          - Multi-pod log tailing'
                >&2 echo '  kubectx/kubens - Context and namespace switching'
                >&2 echo '  kustomize      - Template-free customization'
                >&2 echo '  skopeo         - Container image operations'
                >&2 echo '  tomlq          - TOML processor (jq for TOML)'
                >&2 echo
                if [ "$_podman_ready" = "1" ]; then
                  >&2 echo "DOCKER_HOST=$DOCKER_HOST"
                else
                  >&2 echo -e '\033[1;31mPodman socket not available. Start it with:\033[0m'
                  >&2 echo
                  >&2 echo '  systemctl --user start podman.socket'
                  >&2 echo
                  >&2 echo 'Or without systemd (--log-level=error suppresses harmless /var/run mount warnings):'
                  >&2 echo
                  >&2 echo '  mkdir -p $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/podman && podman --log-level=error system service --time=0 unix://$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/podman/podman.sock &'
                fi
                >&2 echo
                >&2 echo 'Quick start:'
                >&2 echo '  1. Create cluster:  ./deploy/local-k8s.sh'
                >&2 echo '  2. Setup cache:     ./utils/bring_up_cache.sh'
                >&2 echo

content.text: The live process tree identifies the cause: `dockerd` is ready, but its `sudo -b` process inherited a private `direnv` pipe. `direnv` waits for that pipe to close for the full daemon lifetime. `neocache` prevents this by closing all file descriptors above stderr before it detaches a long-lived process.

devshell: detach Docker daemon from direnv

Close stdin and all extra file descriptors before sudo starts the runner. Keep the interactive authorization check, then use its cached authorization for the detached command.

You were right. The issue was not authentication.

`sudo -b` inherited an internal `direnv` pipe. Although `dockerd` started successfully, `direnv` waited for that pipe until the daemon stopped.

Fixed in `76c3ae4`:

- Interactive `sudo -v` prompting is restored.
- Extra file descriptors are closed before starting the daemon.
- The detached daemon uses the cached authorization.
- Docker socket startup remains automatic.

Verified the socket served Docker `29.6.2`, and all Nix checks and tests pass. Pushed to both remotes. SourceHut job: `1853039`.

content.text:
That is expected:

- `DOCKER_SOCK` is a filesystem path, suitable for `ls`.
- `DOCKER_HOST` is a Docker connection URI: `unix://$DOCKER_SOCK`.

Use:

```bash
ls -lh "$DOCKER_SOCK"
printf 'DOCKER_HOST=%s\n' "$DOCKER_HOST"
docker info
```
